events.title: HackHindusthan 2026 — 36-Hour National Hackathon
events.tagline: Code. Innovate. Build the Autonomous Future.
events.short_description: Flagship 36-hour national level hackathon bringing together 500+ top developers to solve real-world problems using AI, Web3, and IoT.
events.description:
HackHindusthan 2026 is the premier annual national hackathon hosted by Hindusthan Educational and Charitable Trust. Over 36 hours of relentless innovation, student teams from across the nation will compete across diverse tracks including Generative AI, Smart Healthcare, Sustainable Smart Cities, and Decentralized Systems. 
    
Participants will receive direct mentorship from seasoned industry architects, cloud access credits, round-the-clock technical guidance, gourmet meals, and exciting recreation zones.
events.department: Computer Science & Engineering and Information Technology
events.venue: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Auditorium & Computing Labs, Main Campus
highlights: ₹1,50,000 Grand Prize Pool
Direct Fast-Track Internship Opportunities
Free Cloud Compute & GPU Sandbox Access
Industry Mentors from Top Tech Unicorns
Food, Red Bull & Refreshments fully sponsored

schedule.description: Ideation and prototype architecture setup.

schedule.description: Technical review and feasibility assessment with assigned mentors.

schedule.description: Recharge session with arcade gaming and snacks.

schedule.title: Mentor Checkpoint 2 (Semi-Finals)
schedule.description: Functional code demo and progress audit.

schedule.title: Final Pitching to Jury & Award Ceremony
schedule.description: Top 10 teams pitch on main stage. Winners announced.

rules: Team size must be between 2 to 4 members.
All code, designs, and assets must be developed during the hackathon period.
Pre-existing codebases are strictly prohibited; open source libraries and APIs are permitted.
Strict adherence to the student code of conduct and academic integrity.
events.eligibility: Open to all undergraduate and postgraduate engineering, polytechnic, and arts & science students with valid college ID.

events.title: FRAME FEST 2026 — Inter-College Cultural Extravaganza
events.tagline: Colors of Youth. Rhythms of Passion.
events.short_description: The mega annual cultural festival featuring music concerts, pro-shows, western & classical dance, theatrical drama, fashion walks, and culinary arts.
events.description:
FRAME FEST is Hindusthan Educational Trust's grand cultural fiesta celebrating youth talent, performing arts, and creative expression. With over 6,000 student attendees representing 80+ colleges, FRAME FEST 2026 transforms the campus into a dynamic wonderland of lights, melodies, and dramatic choreography.
    
The 3-day carnival hosts 25+ competitive events culminating in a star-studded celebrity musical evening.

events.title: Cloud Native & Generative AI Architecture Masterclass
events.tagline: Deploying Scalable Agentic Systems with Kubernetes & LLMs.
events.short_description: An intensive, hands-on masterclass led by principal cloud architects on container orchestration, microservices, and LLM fine-tuning.
events.description:
A hands-on, deep-dive workshop tailored for software engineers and aspiring cloud architects. Participants will build and deploy a production-grade multi-agent LLM application on Kubernetes clusters, implementing enterprise observability, Redis caching, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
    
Due to computing workstation limits, registrations for this cohort are closed.
highlights: Each participant receives a dedicated $100 Cloud Lab Instance
Live containerization with Docker and Kubernetes cluster rollout
Building RAG pipelines with Vector Databases and LangChain
Official Certificate of Completion recognized by Cloud Alliance

schedule.description: Vector embeddings and cosine similarity search.

schedule.description: Deploying agents with Prometheus and Grafana metrics.
